demos.title: Deployment Agent
demos.teaches: Write a deployment sub-agent with frontmatter, a scoped shell allowlist, a deploy-manifest.json it reads instead of remembering, and a contract that makes it prove a result rather than describe one.

demos.title: Bootstrap & Harden
demos.teaches: Drive an Ubuntu host bootstrap over SSH: access, a non-root deploy user, patching, unattended upgrades, Docker Engine with the Compose plugin, key-only SSH and a firewall, each step proved against the host.

demos.title: Compose, Caddy & TLS
demos.teaches: Ship the app onto the hardened box: complete the Compose file with a single public Caddy edge, write the Caddyfile site blocks, then prove the certificate and the redeploy instead of asserting them.

demos.title: Agentic SEO & Lighthouse CI
demos.teaches: Take a scored baseline with the agentic-seo skill, gate LCP, TBT and CLS with a Lighthouse CI job after the deploy, apply findings to the layer that owns them, then compare the snapshots.
